title: Lead Engineer - IT
jobDescription: Job Description: Java Full Stack Developer (5–8 Years Experience) We are seeking a highly skilled Java Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in Spring Boot, Microservices, and solid Core Java fundamentals. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in developing scalable, high‑performance applications, along with proficiency in relational databases, CI/CD pipelines, and testing frameworks. Familiarity with AWS and modern Dev Ops practices will be an added advantage. Experience with event-driven architecture while working with platforms such as Kafka, SNS/SQS is also valuable. In addition, front-end development experience is required, with a preference for React JS or Angular JS. The candidate will be expected to contribute to front-end development as a core part of their role. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain Java-based applications using Spring Boot and Microservices architecture. Build and implement RESTful APIs, ensuring efficient communication and integration across services. Develop, optimize, and maintain database schemas and queries for My SQL and Postgre SQL. Apply object-oriented principles and design patterns to deliver clean, modular, and maintainable code. Develop and maintain front-end applications using React JS or Angular JS, working closely with UI/UX designers to deliver seamless user experiences. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, Git, and Maven/Gradle. Write, execute, and maintain unit and integration tests using frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito. Collaborate with QA, Dev Ops, Product Management, and other cross-functional teams. Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting issues, and perform application performance tuning. Stay up to date with emerging technologies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. Ability to debug, analytical skills, prod support. Required Skills & Qualifications 5–8 years of professional development experience in Java & front-end technologies. Strong proficiency in Core Java (Collections, Multithreading, Exception Handling, Streams, etc.). Hands-on experience with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and Microservices architecture. Solid understanding of RESTful services and API design principles. Experience working with My SQL and Postgre SQL databases. Experience with front-end development using React JS or Angular JS. The candidate must be able to contribute to front-end coding, troubleshooting, and collaboration with UI/UX teams. Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Git, Maven/Gradle). Proficiency in unit testing frameworks (JUnit, Mockito). Good understanding of software design principles and common design patterns. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills. Familiarity with AWS services (ECS, EKS, EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda) is a plus. Leveraging AI productivity tools such as Github Co-pilot. Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
